title: Second moment under binary sign encoding
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The mean of the square of the function on the sign cube obtained by decoding each sign as a bit equals the mean of $f^2$ on the binary cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the binary cube
